🕹️ Warning: This is What The Fight, NOT WTF
💀 No normal fights here — just ridiculous memes beating the crap out of each other!
🥴 Absurd Abilities × Crazy Characters × Pure Meme Chaos

✨ NEW MEMES JUST DROPPED ✨
🎃 A vampire drinks your health, a witch jinxes your game, and a mummy wraps you up tight... and that's just the start! 🧛🧙🧟😂
🎃 Plus a pumpkin head that rolls into battle, and a black cat crossing your path with bad luck — along with a whole bunch more! 🎃🐈😱

🏆 There's no strongest fighter — only the funniest one.

👍 Like the game + join the group to unlock a guy who throws records EVERYWHERE. 😂
⚠️ The game is still in alpha!
Have a meme character or ability you want to see? Submit your ideas — your meme might make it into the next update!
